# TCP connect (`source_type: tcp`)

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-probe-refs.ts from packages/probe-config. Do not edit by hand. -->

Opens a TCP connection and reports the connect time in milliseconds.

- Runs on: an Observer Agent (set the metric's `agent` to its name)
- Thresholds: required when the metric is created (all four fields)
- testProbe: supported

## Value and unit

- `ms`: TCP connect time in milliseconds

## source_config fields

| Field | Required | Type | Default | Limits |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `host` | yes | string |  |  |
| `port` | yes | integer |  | 1 to 65535 |
| `timeout_ms` | no | integer | `2000` | 1 to 60000 |

## Example

```yaml
source_type: tcp
source_config: {"host":"db.internal","port":5432}
```
